tickets.text: Minority note: the trend is clean (HH/HL on W, D and H1), but price is away from value (extension_atr_20 3.66). An hourly close over bar_high at the high is a chase, not the test (C3, C15, R2). I join on the test of structure_shift_ref or pvp_vah, then a sign-of-strength buy stop over that bar's high (C7, C12). Wrong if price closes back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR.

Minority note: buyers in control into the close, but price is away from value (extension_atr_20 3.55) after an H1 close at 99% of range. Buying the hourly close over bar_high is a chase, not the test (C3, C15, R2). Wait for the corrective wave into structure_shift_ref or pvp_vah, then a sign-of-strength buy stop (C7, C12). Wrong if price closes back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR.

The pause should name a level: the test of the broken Creek (structure_shift_ref) or pvp_vah, ideally on light selling volume, then a sign-of-strength bar with the buy stop over its high (C7, C12, R2). A heavy-volume close back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR ends it (C5, C11).

Add the structural read: the tight base should form at or above the broken Creek (structure_shift_ref) or pvp_vah, on light volume, before the buy stop counts (C7, C3). A heavy-volume close back under the Creek, i.e. re-entry into the old range, ends the trend case (C5, C11).

Add the value read: a light-volume test that holds the broken pivot 529.89 raises it (C7); a heavy-volume daily close back under it, re-entering the old range, ends it (C5, C11). The trigger stays a buy stop over a sign-of-strength bar, never a resting limit (C12).
